title: AI opening and factory fix
body: Fixed an opening-planner stall that left AIs building mexes without factories. Deferred terrain routes are checked again, and the AI can start local production while map analysis finishes.

title: AI startup crash fix
body: Fixed a crash while loading the AI unit catalog. The new AI code now uses the string functions supported by the game, including factory output checks, research categories and ability selection.

title: Reforger AI update
body: The AI reacts to nearby fights before spending time on base management. Damaged heavy units stay back to recover, and ground tanks no longer count as protection against bombers. Research follows the current tree and only counts as spent once it unlocks. The AI can use legal foreign factories, plan compatible experimental production and attempt paid teleport or jump moves with nearby units. The Reforged Balance startup fix is included.

title: Reforged Balance startup fix
body: Fixed a crash when loading Reforged Balance. The Orion and Javelin blueprint hooks now load correctly during game startup and replay playback.

title: Game launch fix
body: Fixed an archive size limit that stopped Reforged Balance games from launching. Linux now has a single-file installer.

title: Linux preview
body: Reforged now has a Linux client. It finds your Steam installation and launches Reforged Balance skirmishes and replays through Proton. Ranked matchmaking still runs through the Windows client.

title: Javelin airframe update
body: The Javelin has a new delta-wing airframe. Its bomb bay opens before dropping a single charge, and the impact sends a ring across the ground.

title: Readable research in replays and spectating
body: Tab opens the readable research tree in replays and spectator mode. Research popups now show Training ranks the same way the tree does.

title: Replay scoreboard and research popups
body: The replay and spectator scoreboard sits flush with the bottom of the screen. Research popups are centered above the scoreboard, and the replay controls move aside when they would overlap it.

title: Orion visual update
body: Orion has a rebuilt model, a moving shutter, and new beam, impact, and exhaust effects. Its beam lasts three seconds with the same damage budget per burst.

title: Jerrico splash damage
body: Jerrico shells now deal light splash damage to nearby enemies. Each direct hit still deals 700 damage. Catapult rocket models are 15% smaller.

title: Heavy defense damage and construction
body: The new structures use their original build animations again, and the scaffold packs up when construction finishes. Catapult rockets leave thicker smoke and do splash damage. The Jerrico can take out a standard tank in three hits, and the Orion’s beam hits harder. Heavy point defenses now cost 420 to 490 mass.

title: Heavy defenses and community maps
body: Catapult rockets are bigger, fly on a lower arc, and spread out a bit when they land. There’s a longer pause between salvos. Heavy point defenses all reach farther, with Cybran out in front, then UEF, then Illuminate. The new defenses and reactors have scaffolding sized to fit, and community maps install under their published filenames.

title: Catapult and Hyper Rail Reactor
body: Catapult now fires heavy rockets on a high arc, with a thicker smoke trail and a heavier impact. The Hyper Rail Reactor’s Vent command is disabled while we investigate a crash on selection.

title: Build icon direction
body: The 17 new Reforged Balance build icons now match the direction of the existing set.

title: Reforged Balance unit fixes
body: The new build icons use faction colors in the Reforged HUD and stay white in Classic. Strategic zoom icons use the same texture format as the stock icons. Jerrico fires its three barrels half a second apart, and Catapult has a new missile trail. Ahwassa II makes forward bombing passes, construction effects scale with the new structures, and Jerrico and the Fusion Reactor have revised team colors.

title: Reforged Balance unit fixes
body: Jerrico fires three shells in quick succession before reloading. Orion and Catapult use faction-specific weapon effects. Ahwassa II is larger, flies like a bomber, and builds at the Experimental Gantry. The new structures are bigger, Cybran structures rise out of the ground, and land scouts got movement and visual fixes.

title: Research popups while watching
body: Research completions show up above the replay controls and while spectating. The cards stay tied to new unlocks, so skipping ahead in a replay clears old popups. This release also comes with a full Windows installer.

title: 17 units for Reforged Balance
body: Reforged Balance has 17 new units, all available from the start of a match.

title: Jump Jet and Teleport range
body: Aim Jump Jet or Teleport to see how far the selected unit can go. The ring stays centered on the unit and includes any distance upgrades you’ve researched. Works in both HUDs.

title: Build prices, Caster badge and leaderboard
body: Build prices update when you finish the relevant research. Classic clears unused build slots as you switch tabs, and factories stick to Units and Factory Add-ons. The Caster badge is available, and the leaderboard has a canyon banner and filters that update as you change them. This was the first pass at Jump Jet and Teleport range rings.

title: Build menus and replay scoreboards
body: The Illuminate Tactical Missile Launcher appears on the first Combat page once unlocked, alongside the Anti-Air Tower and Light Point Defense. Classic factories have Units and Factory Add-ons tabs. Replays save available match-start Forge Ratings and badges. Reforged queue icons use faction colors, while Classic uses white.

title: HUD startup fix
body: Rolled back a queue rendering change that caused trouble at startup. Factory queues temporarily used neutral icons in both HUDs.

title: Drag-move and website sign-in
body: Draw formations in either HUD. In Classic, hold Ctrl to clump units. You can stay signed in on the website and desktop at the same time, using your username or verified email. Account creation has its own page, and Discord, Patreon and Ko-fi links are in both footers.

title: Reforged controls with stock balance
body: Vanilla + Infinite War Battle Pack picked up Reforged movement, attack-move, area reclaim and repair, and priority queue controls. The original units, research, AI and mass conversion still play as before.

title: Classic controls and the Vanilla Plus name
body: Classic got white build and selection icons, its original drag-to-form movement and Ctrl-to-clump. Engineers and commanders can work along an attack-move route. Vanilla Plus became the name for the enhanced ruleset.

title: Stock lobby startup and client buttons
body: Fixed a crash when opening an Infinite War Battle Pack lobby. The Discord setup button opens a visible console and reports progress, and the Support button takes you to the website.

title: Three ways to play
body: Custom games can choose Vanilla Plus, the original game with Infinite War Battle Pack, or Reforged Balance. Admins can publish research and balance patches separately and set the official ladder patch. Replays remember which patch the match used.

title: Resize individual HUD panels
body: Resize and position panels separately in both HUDs. Replay controls moved to the bottom center, and the Support Reforged page added Patreon and Ko-fi options.

title: Classic HUD cleanup
body: Build costs now sit clear of the queue, the unit cap appears once, and conversion has its own background. The Classic minimap sits at the right edge with idle units below it, and the Options button has a background.

title: Display settings and research progress
body: Fixed a Display settings bug that could trap mouse input. The Classic research progress bar moved below the label and total.

title: HUD editor and Classic hotkeys
body: Preview, scale and move HUD panels from Preferences. Classic got its own editable hotkeys and horizontal build tabs. Both HUDs show research progress, and Ctrl+Shift+right-click works on queued orders again.

title: Classic Reforged HUD
body: Switch between Classic and Reforged in game. The client remembers the HUD choice per game profile.

title: Faster range overlays
body: Reduced repeated range calculations when selecting large armies, especially when units share overlapping intel coverage.

title: Large selections
body: Overlapping range rings take less work to draw. Their outlines still connect and keep gaps where coverage breaks. Added timing logs for selection slowdowns.

title: Bigger scoreboard text
body: Player names, column headings, Forge Ratings and economy numbers are easier to read. Live economy stats are visible for you and your teammates.

title: Economy totals and research in replays
body: The scoreboard shows stored Mass, Energy and Research with income next to each total. Spectators and replay viewers can see every army’s available totals. This build also added research completion tracking for observer popups.

title: Missing HUD fix
body: Fixed the HUD disappearing after 0.36.9. Older replays use the repaired HUD with the simulation they were recorded on.

title: HUD performance and selection feedback
body: Cut down on repeated work during large selections and range updates. Added new selection art and a brief highlight when you select units.

title: Ping startup crash
body: Fixed a crash in the game’s ping setup. Launch diagnostics once again include the full recorded launch history.

title: Launch recovery retries
body: Each recovery attempt gets a fresh game folder. Once a repaired copy launches successfully, the client uses it the next time.

title: Recovering from old interfaces
body: Fixed launch recovery for copies that were last used with custom research or a replay. The launcher shows more detail about the step it’s checking.

title: Interface check timeouts
body: Fixed launches timing out at the interface check and made progress visible while the client verifies the game files.

title: Guest launches and unit animations
body: Restored guest launch preparation, cleaned up the ladder lobby, and fixed an error when inspecting units without veterancy data. Reduced replay HUD work and added unit animations.

title: Ranked guest readiness
body: Ranked guests can ready up again. The lobby got wider Player columns and fixes for stray badge tooltips and the map backdrop.

title: Research cards and battle feedback
body: Added compact research cards with the upgrade icon, branch and affected units. Construction, veterancy, shields, teleport, jump jets and capture got new feedback. Restored signed client updates for older playtest builds.

title: Badge tooltips and update status
body: Badge tooltips clear when you move away. The client shows its installed version and tells you when sign-in or an unpublished update is the reason you can’t update.

title: Orders, hotkeys and earned badges
body: Orders got path chevrons and waypoint markers. Profiles show earned badges, with playtime from ladder, custom, unranked and co-op matches. Reclaim, Repair and Repeat Build moved to E, R and T.

title: Lobby badges and map uploads
body: Badges sit between the avatar and player name. Map checks run in the background and flag duplicate uploads. The playtest application was shortened.

title: Intel coverage and replay maps
body: Overlapping intel rings take less work to draw, weapon rings stay thin up close, and replay minimap terrain is back. Right-click attacks work again on eligible targets.

title: Combined intel rings and DLC units
body: Selected units share an outline where their radar, sonar or omni ranges overlap. The website unit list picked up missing DLC units, including the Monkeylord.

title: Battle startup crash
body: Fixed a crash while loading weapon changes and strategic icons. The same fix applies when opening affected 0.35.0 and 0.35.1 replays.

title: AI expansion and experimental units
body: AI engineers look for reachable mass and pull back from threats. UEF and Cybran AIs can plan gantries and pay for unlocked Fatboys and Megaliths.

title: Range rings and balance changes
body: Thin terrain-following rings returned. The Titan’s main cannon fires faster for about 5% more DPS, and the Illuminate Tactical Missile Launcher range dropped from 225 to 200. The Intellitron joined the unit catalogue.

title: Range rings and observer research
body: Overlapping weapon coverage joins into one outline. Tab opens read-only research when watching a match, and the tree shows completed upgrades and the Afterburn icon.

title: Replay selection and research display
body: Replay and spectator drag boxes clear properly on deselection. The research tree clears stale icons when you switch branches and marks completed upgrades.

title: Player View and team comparison
body: Switching Player View clears active inspection gestures and keeps team comparison visible. The research viewer also got Training I–V badges.

title: Spectator tools
body: Inspect units and open read-only faction research trees during replays and live spectating. Range outlines follow terrain and combine coverage for selected units.

title: Attack-move and formation shortcuts
body: Alt+right-click issues attack-move and Ctrl+right-click moves units in formation. Orders play their sound once, and B switches between factory units and add-ons.

title: Cobra and Intellitron from match start
body: Both Cybran units became available from the start of a match. The Intellitron’s model and selection marker shrank to scout size.

title: Replay minimap and TMD art
body: Fixed replay minimap textures and added a Reforged End Replay prompt. Tactical Missile Defense got model-based icons and faction construction scaffolds.

title: Research relaunch and Cybran Light PD
body: Fixed a launch failure after editing research. Cybran Light PD now rises straight out of the ground during construction.

title: TMD startup crash
body: Fixed a crash while loading Tactical Missile Defense blueprints. Windows installers moved to a consistent filename.

title: Tactical Missile Defense
body: All three factions got a Tactical Missile Defense structure. Formations show each unit’s destination and play a move sound, and the AI got a fix for stalling after research.

title: Lobby connections and firewall checks
body: Cleaned up the connection panel after you create a lobby. The client remembers firewall permission checks and gives clearer diagnostics.

title: Adaptive AI
body: Custom games got adaptive opponents with improved expansion, scouting, production and team coordination.

title: New unit models and icons
body: Updated the Caliper model and the Swab, Caliper, Conduit and Centurion icons. The Conduit got hover effects, and the Swab and Caliper animations were adjusted for the game renderer.

title: Centurion unlock
body: Researching the Centurion also unlocks its UEF Land Experimental Gantry. The research tooltip explains the dependency.

title: Research editor unit list
body: The research editor can assign unlocks for all added units, including the three reclamation bots. It keeps the original faction research details and existing drafts.

title: Replay terrain and Centurion
body: Replay minimaps use the installed map preview for terrain. Ending a replay goes through the original score transition. This build also added the Centurion.

title: Converter timing and replay terrain
body: Fixed a simulation timing error in passive converters. Replay minimaps can load the actual terrain image, including images shared between maps.

title: Converter status and replay minimaps
body: Converters register when construction finishes, and the HUD shows their energy use in red. Replay minimaps load terrain through the game’s texture paths.

title: HUD fit and game executable
body: Restored a compact HUD and aligned the native controls with the live window. Hosting, joining and replays share one executable in each managed game copy.

title: Right-click targets and structure income
body: Right-click targets enemy units and unidentified radar contacts as expected. Structure details show Mass, Energy and Research production, including in replays.

title: Website and playtest installer
body: The Windows installer now includes the website and closed playtest changes, with the existing server upgrade flow.

title: Public Reforged website
body: Launched the homepage with current games, changelog and account sign-in, plus a playtest download flow.

title: AI late-game stall
body: Fixed an error where a destroyed enemy unit could stall both AIs.

title: Replay pause controls
body: Added yellow Play and Pause icons, with the button updating immediately to reflect the replay state.

title: Custom lobby player controls
body: Restored Team, Color and Faction buttons on all eight custom lobby slots.

title: AI opening and construction fixes
body: Fixed early-game stalls caused by overlapping build placements. Improved build-range handling, expansion and idle builder recovery.

title: Lobby scaling
body: Lobby sizing is independent of the battle HUD scale. The commander table and Income column keep their wider layout.

title: AI startup and lobby columns
body: Fixed a timing error that blocked AI startup. Lobby names have more room, and Income has its own column beside Ping.

title: Custom lobby startup crash
body: Fixed the game loading error in the AI and lobby options while keeping the existing options and per-slot income settings.

title: Lobby diagnostic build
body: Released the diagnostic installer with consistent version labels and excluded temporary native files from setup.

title: Lobby crash diagnostics
body: Added Lua crash details to the game log to help trace the lobby startup issue.

title: AI attack and reclaim decisions
body: AIs stay on attack orders while they’re making progress, prioritize reachable wreckfields and check visibility before sending engineers in.

title: Four AI difficulties
body: Custom games got Easy, Normal, Hard and Reforger AI presets. They scout, expand, reclaim and pay for units using the same economy rules as players.

title: Ladder auto-start and spawns
body: Fixed ladder countdowns and spawn synchronization for independent hosts. Commander and faction values have more room in the lobby.

title: Ladder staging screen
body: Added a map backdrop, player ratings, factions and a five-second countdown to the ladder lobby. Thin range outlines returned in game.

title: Ladder Assassination and range rings
body: Ladder games enforce Assassination. The HUD draws thin weapon, build, radar, sonar and omni ranges on terrain.

title: Unit order capabilities
body: Move, repair and reclaim check the capabilities each unit declares, including units that store several orders in one flag.

title: Saved hotkeys and order input
body: Fixed saved hotkey setup in the game. A hotkey error no longer interrupts right-click move, formations, repair or reclaim.

title: Area order previews and hotkey entry points
body: Area previews clear when you release the mouse. All three hotkey menu entry points open the Reforged editor.

title: Hotkey setup during loading
body: The hotkey editor opens while input is still initializing and retries binding setup without dropping saved keys.

title: Exporting failed launches
body: Early launch failures can be exported even when no game folder was prepared. The Replays page includes a diagnostics shortcut that works offline.

title: Server migration and match listings
body: Server migration waits for saves and uploads. Custom match listings use the final map and teams even when they change right before launch.

title: Community map repository
body: Signed-in users can upload SCD or ZIP map packs, add titles and credits, search the library and download original packages.

title: Lobby map changes
body: Changing the map in the game lobby updates the listing and preview in the desktop client.

title: Open lobbies and games in progress
body: Custom Games separates joinable lobbies from live matches. Running games show the map, starting players and an approximate timer.

title: Co-op preview and research editing
body: Added Coming Soon cards for Survival and Roguelike Survival. Research drafts can set starting units, import icons and edit prerequisite connections.

title: Research workshop preview
body: The Admin workshop added faction trees, editable draft nodes and shared bonuses, with search and undo. This preview saved drafts for later work.

title: Legacy replay HUD
body: Added a Reforged HUD for original-game replays that keeps the original simulation. HUD resizing works while playback is paused.

title: Replay folders and local watching
body: The client remembers the replay folder and lets you watch local replays from the sign-in screen.

title: Move and area order cleanup
body: Move and attack-move leave stationary and factory queues alone. Area repair and reclaim disarm after one order, or stay armed while holding Shift.

title: Quick area drags
body: Area repair and reclaim respond to quick drags. Right-clicking units still uses the game’s normal context orders.

title: Formation and area order input
body: Added a drag threshold before formation markers appear. Area repair and reclaim can be armed directly from their hotkeys.

title: Formation drag previews
body: Hold and drag to preview curved or circular formations. Releasing or losing the input clears the preview.

title: Accurate click-to-repair
body: A single repair click uses the unit you clicked, including structures with large footprints. Area reclaim reads the mass actually left in visible wrecks.

title: Native input crash
body: Fixed the input crash introduced in 0.27.3.

title: Order gestures and hotkey rows
body: Fixed several move, repair and reclaim gesture issues and made the main Orders rows easier to load and display.

title: Stop, Guard and fire mode
body: S stops units, G guards, and G stops selected factories. Fire-mode cycling moved to E, and reclaim overlays show remaining mass.

title: Grid hotkeys and priority queues
body: Added contextual order hotkeys. Alt can insert a factory item after the active order, and Space can place a structure after the builder’s current job.

title: Server recovery and HUD text
body: The sign-in screen shows the selected server and offers connection recovery. HUD text uses Arial Bold, and Sand joined the color palette.

title: Kestrel paint and ratings
body: Kestrel team paint keeps the model’s surface detail. Forge Rating and Games Played headers align over their columns.

title: Scout icons and build keys
body: Kestrel and Falcion got new build icons and moved to X beside the engineer on Z. Their faction transports moved to C.

title: Scout materials and lobby colors
body: Corrected scout team colors and texture channels, enabled native glow, and restored rectangular lobby color swatches.

title: Scout loading fix
body: Fixed scout registration during blueprint loading and added per-stage logs for tracking future load errors.

title: Game colors and launch diagnostics
body: Fixed palette loading and added Windows application error details to game launch diagnostics when available.

title: Replay HUD sizing
body: Replay controls and text fit the actual window, and the toolbar stays clear of the scoreboard. Minimap initialization waits for the game to be ready.

title: Party matchmaking and maps
body: Parties queue only when they share an eligible map. Ongoing games remain listed if a guest closes the game.

title: Eight-player networking and matchmaking
body: Added eight-player independent networking, parties and map pools for 1v1 through 4v4 and 4-, 6- and 8-player FFA. Ladder and custom ratings are tracked separately.

title: Lobby options and spectators
body: Restored Unit Cap and Prebuilt Units, restyled the Exclusions window, and fixed spectator names in the lobby.

title: Map browser visibility
body: Fixed map browser controls that could appear while the browser was closed.

title: In-game map browser
body: Added a six-thumbnail map browser with paging and host map selection. Settings and spectator names got more room.

title: Native lobby redesign
body: The lobby got a larger commander table, chat, a map and settings sidebar, and faction art.

title: First branded game lobby
body: Added Reforged branding to the native lobby and a Restore option for the original interface.

title: Public server setup
body: Added a Windows Admin wizard to set up the public community server in Docker Desktop and check local and HTTPS access separately.

title: Automatic owner server startup
body: Owners can start their saved account server when the client opens and stop it from Admin. The client remembers selected connections.

title: Standalone Server Manager
body: Added a tray app to manage a server independently of the client, remember its address and export connection files for players.

title: Sign-in field focus
body: Fixed password and PIN fields losing focus while the client refreshed.

title: Accounts and Admin
body: Added account startup, profile password changes, remembered sign-in and an owner-provisioned Admin PIN.

title: Installer shutdown and logo
body: Fixed a Windows installer race when the old app closes. The client and installer switched to the transparent logo.

title: Map browser and Reforged branding
body: Added a local map browser with search, player filters and a Host on this map button. The client got the Reforged logo and faction artwork.
